# README - Subsetting & Preprocessing

Hey all, this R Markdown document contains the preprocessing and quality-control workflow for the VD2 γδ T cell subset extracted from the full CITE-seq dataset based on ADT (surface protein) expression.

The goal is to generate a clean, analysis-ready VD2 object for downstream analyses (e.g. differential expression and functional analysis in separate R Markdown files).

This analysis starts from a pre-filtered VD2-enriched Seurat object (`VD2_cells_ADTmoreThan1_2_JOINED.rds`) defined by a CLR-normalized VD2 marker threshold (\> 1.2), selected based on a bimodal expression distribution in the full dataset. The object contains RNA and ADT assays together with donor, sample, and condition metadata.

The preprocessing includes filtering out ribosomal genes, retaining the top 85% variable genes, and restricting the dataset to protein-coding genes and lncRNAs. RNA and ADT layers are independently normalized (log-normalization and CLR normalization respectively) and scaled.

Dimensionality reduction is performed using PCA for both modalities, followed by batch correction using Harmony at the sample level. UMAP embeddings are computed from the Harmony-corrected space.

The final output is a cleaned and QC-filtered VD2 Seurat object containing processed RNA and ADT assays, PCA/Harmony/UMAP embeddings, and curated metadata, which serves as the input for downstream differential expression and functional analyses in separate workflows.

# Load data and inspect

```{r,echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics("hist_ADT_thr.png")
```

we look at the histogram of the VD2 surface marker distributions and identify a bimodal distribution.

```{r,echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics("hist_ADT_thr_celltypeCOLOR.png")
```

Looking at the cell type composition of the cells in each bin of expression we can see that the higher end cells are labelled as VD2 cells based on the RNA annotation using SingleR and the monaco immune atlas db as reference. The cells in the middle of the two distribution masses are a mix of vd and vd2 cells.

We set the threshold at normalized CLR expression of 1.2 for the VD2 surface marker, resulting in the following dataset :

```{r}
proj_dir = getwd()

VD2_cells = readRDS(file.path(proj_dir,"VD2_cells_ADTmoreThan1_2_JOINED.rds"))

VD2_cells
```

## Top variable genes filtration 
```{r}
DefaultAssay(VD2_cells) = "RNA"

rna_features = rownames(VD2_cells[["RNA"]])

ribo_genes = grep("^RP[SL]", rna_features, value = TRUE)

non_ribo_rna_genes <- setdiff(rna_features, ribo_genes)
protein_features <- rownames(VD2_cells[["Protein"]])
VD2_cells <- subset(VD2_cells, features = c(non_ribo_rna_genes, protein_features))

counts <- GetAssayData(
  VD2_cells,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts"
)

gene_variance <- apply(counts, 1, var)

```

```{r}
log_var <- log1p(gene_variance)

quantile(log_var, probs = c(0.5, 0.8, 0.9, 0.99, 0.9999), na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
log_var <- log1p(gene_variance)
q85 <- quantile(log_var, probs = 0.85, na.rm = TRUE)

# Ensure xlim covers from 0 to the maximum value (~9 or higher)
hist(
  log_var,
  breaks = 100, 
  xlim = c(0, max(log_var, na.rm = TRUE)),
  main = "Histogram of log1p(gene_variance)", 
  xlab = "log1p(gene_variance)", 
  col = "lightblue", 
  border = "white"
)

abline(v = q85, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

legend("topright", legend = paste0("85% Quantile: ", round(q80, 3)), col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```


```{r}
variance_threshold = quantile(gene_variance, 0.85, na.rm = TRUE)
genes_use = names(gene_variance)[gene_variance >= variance_threshold]
genes_final = setdiff(genes_use, ribo_genes)

protein_features = rownames(VD2_cells[["Protein"]])
all_features_to_keep = c(genes_final, protein_features)

# Filter out the 3280-1 sample and subset features
VD2_cells = subset(VD2_cells, subset = sample != "3280-1", features = all_features_to_keep)


```


## cell type filtration

Before we move on, we filter all reads which come from regions that are not protein-coding or lncRNA.

```{r}
library(biomaRt)

DefaultAssay(VD2_cells) = "RNA"
genes = rownames(VD2_cells[["RNA"]])

ensembl = useEnsembl(
  biomart = "genes",
  dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version = 114)

# ,
#   mirror = "useast"   
# )

gene_info = getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "gene_biotype"),
                  filters = "external_gene_name",
                  values = genes,
                  mart = ensembl)

# saveRDS(gene_info,"gene_info_0.85VAR.RDS")

```

```{r}
# Keep only protein-coding genes and lncRNAs

# #percent of reads retained:
# length(gene_info_pc_lnc$external_gene_name)/length(gene_info$external_gene_name)


gene_info_pc_lnc = gene_info[
  gene_info$gene_biotype %in% c("protein_coding", "lncRNA"), 
]

genes_rna_keep = intersect(rownames(VD2_cells[["RNA"]]), gene_info_pc_lnc$external_gene_name)
protein_features = rownames(VD2_cells[["Protein"]])

VD2_cells = subset(VD2_cells, features = c(genes_rna_keep, protein_features))
```

```{r, echo=F, include=FALSE}
# Map suffix 1 → pre, suffix 2 → post
VD2_cells$suffix = ifelse(VD2_cells$suffix == "1", "pre",
                          ifelse(VD2_cells$suffix == "2", "post", VD2_cells$suffix))

#extract donor name from sample name
VD2_cells$donor = gsub("-[12]$", "", VD2_cells$sample)

VD2_cells$aEIR = ifelse(VD2_cells$sample %in% c("3280-1", "3280-2","3309-1"), "high", "low")

```

# renormalization

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# REMOVE ALL EXISTING REDUCTIONS
# ---------------------------
VD2_cells@reductions = list()

VD2_cells@graphs = list()

# ---------------------------
# RNA PIPELINE
# ---------------------------
DefaultAssay(VD2_cells) = "RNA"

VD2_cells = NormalizeData(VD2_cells)
VD2_cells = FindVariableFeatures(VD2_cells)

VD2_cells = ScaleData(VD2_cells)

VD2_cells = RunPCA(VD2_cells, reduction.name = "rna_pca_vd2", npcs = 50)
elbow_plot = ElbowPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "rna_pca_vd2", ndims=50)


############### var explained by PC (and cumulative)

# variance explained
pct = VD2_cells[["rna_pca_vd2"]]@stdev^2
pct_var = pct / sum(pct) * 100

df = data.frame(
  PC = seq_along(pct_var),
  Variance = pct_var
)

df$cumVar = cumsum(df$Variance)

# plot (variance + cumulative variance)
scree_plot = ggplot(df[1:50, ], aes(x = PC)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = Variance), stat = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cumVar), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cumVar), color = "red") +
  xlab("Principal Components") +
  ylab("Variance explained (%)") +
  ggtitle("PCA Scree Plot") +
  theme_classic()


elbow_plot | scree_plot


VD2_cells = RunHarmony(
  VD2_cells,
  group.by.vars = "sample",
  reduction = "rna_pca_vd2",
  reduction.save = "rna_harmony_vd2"
)

# ElbowPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "rna_harmony_vd2", ndims=50)


VD2_cells = RunUMAP(
  VD2_cells,
  reduction = "rna_harmony_vd2",
  reduction.name = "rna_umap_vd2",
  dims = 1:30
)

```

```{r}

# ---------------------------
# ADT PIPELINE
# ---------------------------
DefaultAssay(VD2_cells) = "Protein"

VD2_cells = NormalizeData(VD2_cells, normalization.method = "CLR")

VD2_cells = ScaleData(VD2_cells)

VD2_cells = RunPCA(VD2_cells, reduction.name = "adt_pca_vd2")
elbow_plot = ElbowPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_pca_vd2")


# variance explained
pct = VD2_cells[["adt_pca_vd2"]]@stdev^2
pct_var = pct / sum(pct) * 100

df = data.frame(
  PC = seq_along(pct_var),
  Variance = pct_var
)

df$cumVar = cumsum(df$Variance)

# plot (variance + cumulative variance)
scree_plot = ggplot(df[1:50, ], aes(x = PC)) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = Variance), stat = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cumVar), color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cumVar), color = "red") +
  xlab("Principal Components") +
  ylab("Variance explained (%)") +
  ggtitle("PCA Scree Plot") +
  theme_classic()


elbow_plot | scree_plot




VD2_cells = RunHarmony(
  VD2_cells,
  group.by.vars = "sample",
  reduction = "adt_pca_vd2",
  reduction.save = "adt_harmony_vd2"
)

VD2_cells = RunUMAP(
  VD2_cells,
  reduction = "adt_harmony_vd2",
  reduction.name = "adt_umap_vd2",
  dims = 1:19
)


```

## Batch Effects

### Donor in ADT

```{r}
p1 = DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_pca_vd2", group.by = "donor", label = F) + ggtitle("ADT layer \n before harmony \n colored by donor")
p2  =DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_harmony_vd2", group.by = "donor", label = F) + ggtitle("ADT layer \n after harmony \n colored by donor")

p1 | p2
```

data from the VD2 cells subset seems to have batch effects for donor in the aDT layer, corrected by harmony for ADT.

```{r}
p3 = FeaturePlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_pca_vd2", features = "nCount_Protein", label = F) + ggtitle("ADT layer\n before harmony ")
p4 = FeaturePlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_harmony_vd2", features = "nCount_Protein", label = F) + ggtitle("ADT layer \n after harmony ")

p3 | p4


ggsave("non_vd2_thr_nCountProtein_ADT_pca.pdf",width=10, height=5)


```


```{r}
p3 = DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_pca_vd2", group.by = "sample", label = F) + ggtitle("ADT layer\n before harmony \n colored by sample")
p4 = DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "adt_harmony_vd2", group.by = "sample", label = F) + ggtitle("ADT layer \n after harmony \n colored by sample")
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}


p5 = DimPlot(VD2_cells, reduction = "rna_pca_vd2", group.by = "donor", label = FALSE) +

  labs(x = "PCA Dimension 1", y = "PCA Dimension 2")

# 2. Add threshold lines to visualize the cutoffs
p5_thresh = p5 + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -20, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)

p6_thresh = p6 + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -20, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8)

# 3. View side by side
p5_thresh | p6_thresh

# 4. Save the plot
ggsave("non_vd2_thr_nCountProtein_RNA_pca_dashed.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)

p6_thresh
ggsave("RNA_harmony_dashed_thr_donor.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)
```
